sessionStart.bash: node -e 'const http = require("http"); const req = http.request("http://127.0.0.1:8764/ui/api/inject", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, timeout: 12000 }, (res) => { let data = ""; res.on("data", (c) => data += c); res.on("end", () => { try { const json = JSON.parse(data); if (json.formatted) { console.log(JSON.stringify({ additionalContext: "[FORESIGHT CONTEXT]\n" + json.formatted + "\n[/FORESIGHT CONTEXT]" })); return; } } catch (_) {} console.log("{}"); }); }); req.on("error", () => console.log("{}")); req.write(JSON.stringify({ text: "current session startup context and user preferences" })); req.end();'
